groups.title: Typed conjunction domain
groups.proposal: Compose typed clause Sources through a licensed conjunction relation, reference graph, ordered realization, and signed sentence Result.
groups.readingJob: Show conjunct ranks, relation, reference graph, order, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Users capture exact Results and select only licensed conjunction profiles.
groups.controlPolicy: Lesson labels, formulas, surfaces, and stored answers authorize nothing.

groups.title: Ordinary and marked conjunction
groups.proposal: Compose unmarked, auh-marked, sentence-initial, adjoined, shared-supplement, and nested clause-group conjunctions.
groups.readingJob: Show marker, rank, shared supplement, nesting, and balanced conjunct structure.
groups.decisionSplit: Relation and rank are choices; marker and supplement placement are derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not invent a head or reconstruct nested clauses from a sentence string.

groups.title: Conjunction modifiers and shared scope
groups.proposal: Apply additive, alternative, adversative, rightward, pre-first shared-scope, in, and ihuan modifier profiles.
groups.readingJob: Show coordination type, modifier, adjunctor role, shared scope, antecedent, and rank.
groups.decisionSplit: Only inventory-backed modifiers are selectable; their semantic roles remain derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not treat in or ihuan as generic conjunctors.

groups.title: Correlative conjunction
groups.proposal: Compose standard and loose correlation through exact paired Results and licensed patterns.
groups.readingJob: Show correlation type, paired pattern, conjunct identity, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Correlation type and licensed pattern are choices; pairing follows captured identity.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not infer a pair from repeated display text.

groups.title: Lexical conjunction
groups.proposal: Compose lord-and-master and bread-and-butter lexical conjunctions with exact shared reference, arity, state realization, and adjunctor distribution.
groups.readingJob: Show lexical type, arity, reference identity, state realization, adjunctor distribution, and downstream compatibility.
groups.decisionSplit: Only Canvas-licensed lexical profiles are productive; downstream compatibility is read-only.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not generalize lexical conjunction or manufacture a downstream handoff.

groups.title: Parallel and rephrasive structure
groups.proposal: Compose rephrasive, appositive, progressive, and combined parallel structures over exact clause Results.
groups.readingJob: Show parallel type, rephrase axis, appositive kind, order, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Parallel type and licensed axis are choices; source facts remain attached to each conjunct.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not merge rephrasing with ordinary coordination from surface similarity.

groups.title: Conjunction constraints and extensions
groups.proposal: Enforce adversative arity, marked-adjoined, modifier, lexical-reference, and downstream-operation boundaries.
groups.readingJob: Show the exact failed prerequisite or compatible extension without changing grammar authority.
groups.decisionSplit: Only owner-available options appear; incompatible selections retain exact block reasons.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not repair an incompatible route from URL, formula, or hidden state.
